item.description:
ScreenTake 0.1.20

  • Add styled text overlays with presets, timing, positioning, rotation, and independent scale controls. Keep text in preview, exports, and editable projects.
  • Use consistent inspector controls and compact timeline tracks for text and narration.
  • Choose one camera presentation style and retain independent Zoom and Auto Zoom settings.
  • Control text overlays and camera styles through a connected AI client in the same editor, with shared Undo.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later.

ScreenTake 0.1.19

  • Upload your own background image and keep it inside saved projects, with consistent previews and export.
  • Choose 16 wallpapers in a square, four-column grid, including new 4K Silk, Pastel, Breeze, and Mint presets.
  • Draw, move, and resize manual zoom regions on recordings, imported videos, and phone layouts.
  • Adjust phone corner rounding separately and use floating phone chrome.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later.

ScreenTake 0.1.17

  • Reduce temporary disk use during imported-video exports while preserving original media, current results, Undo references, and saved projects.
  • Keep generated frames evenly spaced in long imported-video exports with many zooms.
  • Validated a 15-minute imported video with 300 zooms and audio at 1080p. The exact reported failure remains unconfirmed without the original clip or error message.

Includes in-app updates, editing shortcuts, and Mirror Camera. Versions through 0.1.15 need a manual installation.

ScreenTake 0.1.16

  • Download and install updates inside ScreenTake.
  • Enable optional automatic downloads and installation on quit in Settings → Updates.
  • Recording, media processing, and unsaved projects block a restart. Save your editable project first.
  • Update feeds and downloads are signed and verified before installation.
